lesson_title: Below Zero: Integers on a Thermometer
hook_text: −2 °C or −6 °C: which is bigger? Your thermometer knows.
clip_script: Comparing two negative integers is where errors happen. Minus six and minus two: minus two is to the right of minus six, so minus two is greater. On a thermometer: minus two degrees is warmer than minus six. Order the temperatures from coldest to warmest: minus six, minus two, three, fourteen.
visual_style: A tall thermometer with town markers sliding to their temperatures; frost on the negatives; the −2 marker sits visibly above −6.
pacing: Quick question, thermometer reveal, ordered list.
call_to_action: Watch the full lesson to count across zero in any step.
